_about: A fictional case, the Marston County Fair shooting of 2023, used so that no answer can come from what anyone knows of a real event. Levels: 0 predicted, 1 comfortable, 2 strained, 3 contradicted.

hypotheses.h1: One man fired from the grain loft, acting alone (the charged account)
hypotheses.h2: One man fired from the loft, and the sheriff's office is hiding how it missed him
hypotheses.h3: A second shooter fired from the beer tent
hypotheses.h4: The shooting was staged by a state agency and the man in the loft was a patsy

rows.statement: The cartridge case found in the loft was fired in the rifle found beside it.
The accused's DNA is on the rifle's trigger and on the fired case.
Fairground video shows the accused climbing to the loft eleven minutes before the shot.
Audio analysis by two independent labs finds one firing position.
A drone was photographed over the fairground forty minutes before the shot.
The sheriff's office has not released the gate camera footage.
An investigator has said the fired case was planted after the shooting.
A deputy's report says the loft door was found padlocked from outside.
The medical examiner's report has not been made public.
